build_ssd_vgg_backbone: build an SSDVGG backbone network for single-shot detection with input size 300 and depth 11
run_ssd_vgg_forward: run the SSDVGG forward pass on a random input tensor to get multi-scale feature outputs
init_ssd_vgg_weights: initialize SSDVGG backbone weights from a pretrained checkpoint path or with default Kaiming init
build_l2norm_layer: build an L2Norm normalization layer with configurable scale and epsilon for feature map normalization
review_ssd_vgg_extra_layers: review the SSDVGG _make_extra_layers method to understand how extra conv layers are constructed for input sizes 300 and 512
